title: Private Halo HomeKit control IPC v1 (not plugin public v2/v3)
x-runtime-invariants: Decode strict UTF-8; reject duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, >32 container levels, unsafe integers and >65536 byte control bodies before authority.
S06 must compare boot_id to the current child boot and enforce sender direction. Structural validity does not grant account/device/session authority.

Every new request and result is scoped; match profile/account/device/privacy generations at both admission and delivery. Request_id is unique per outstanding request and replies echo it; session/job/operation UUIDs are opaque per-boot owned handles, never SDK IDs or bearer capabilities.

Policy update is complete replacement of all eight booleans. Node closes local admission/delivery immediately and sends the current full scope; the ACK echoes that exact input scope. Python assigns any new privacy generation. Node requires an accepted ACK followed by fresh complete inventory of the same source key before admitting operations. Old scopes, missing ACK or unsynchronized policy remain fail closed.

Inventory cursor is opaque, server-issued and bound to account scope plus revision. Request revision0/cursor null starts a snapshot. A page echoes its input cursor; next_cursor null is terminal. Complete describes authority of the whole frozen inventory revision, not merely a page; reconcile removals only after all pages of the same scope/revision and complete true. Total is exact snapshot device count and <=256; <=32 per page, fewer when needed to fit bytes. No mutation/codec is inferred from capability flags.

Runtime semantic validation additionally enforces page device scope equals page account scope, unique camera_id within each page, page length<=total, progress for next_cursor; across pages S06 must reject repetition, duplicates, revision changes, excess totals and expired cursors.

Observed video frame_rate_num/frame_rate_den<=240 when present; values are evidence, not selected output. Snapshot request width*height<=8000000. These are request ceilings, not guarantees of transform support. No image bytes, base64, credentials, SRTP material or raw SDK records appear in control JSON.
Lease purpose is only homekit_live. TTL<=30000ms never extends the separately enforced absolute lifetime; lease/session ownership survives neither scope nor boot retirement.
Control accepted means request acceptance only, not physical effect. Camera status is an observation; unknown/source absence does not invent online or media metadata.

inventory_reset is a Python-only discovery/invalidation notice: nullable account scope plus revision. It never grants media or policy authority. Every notice retires local stale admissions before fetching bounded inventory pages; policy ACK echoes input scope, then a fresh inventory supplies Python assigned privacy generation.
Video keys/salts use canonical base64 with exact 16/14 decoded bytes; never persist/log them.
Video prepare accepted iff code=ok and endpoint exists; rejected iff non-ok and null endpoint. Other video results accepted iff code=ok.
Network endpoint literals/family/interface and coupled codec/level/catalog constraints are checked by the live owner, beyond structural JSON shape.
Audio speaker graph requires microphone graph; durable mute/volume gates policy and output before every await/delivery.
Classic HAP Opus uses selected sample_rate destination timestamps; source Opus and decoded durations remain48000Hz. This differs from RFC7587 and does not claim Apple qualification.
Accepted audio settings reply revision equals expected or expected+1; full scope echoes submitted epoch. Accepted prepare must echo both tracks negotiated key/salt and optional audio presence.

bulk-cancel-v1 requires producer-owned enqueue frontiers and exact drained ACK correlation; only exact owned transfers or trusted terminal records admit cleanup under retired scopes. Unknown transfers never create authority.

hksv-recording-v1 is required in the ordered hello ACK feature list. Recording settings use complete current scope and expected durable revision; accepted revision equals expected or expected+1. Child active/audio/configuration updates never enable the trusted Python owner warm preference.

Recording selected video uses even geometry<=1920x1080,fps<=30,baseline/main/high and levels3.1/3.2/4.0; runtimes enforce actual H264 level macroblock/frame-rate limits (3600/108000,5120/216000,8192/245760) and3.1 selected bitrate<=17500high or14000otherwise. i_frame_interval_ms>=ceil(1000/fps) and<=4000, honored by actual native IDR cadence; no copied longer GOP may bypass it.

recording_next READY reserves the exact job/sequence/transfer/kind/bytes before reply; the producer waits for reply completion before opening bulk. Init sequence0<=1MiB,duration0; fragment sequence>=1<=8MiB,duration1..4000. EOS/rejected have no transfer/media metadata. Sequence,job,boot,scope and reply request IDs must match. No unknown late READY or unsolicited bulk creates authority.

Optional accessory recording metadata absence disables recording. Enabled is trusted Python owner/capability permission, not a claim that warm history is currently ready. RecordingAudioActive false uses configuration.audio=null and no AAC track. Normal configuration updates apply to the next immutable job; authority revocation immediately fences current deliveries.

owner-admin-v1 is required in ordered hello ACK features. Pairing metadata, explicit secret reveal, and quiescence are separate commands; full scope/registry/accessory/username/revision and boot/request identity must correlate. Status metadata never carries secrets; secret reveal lifetime60000ms is a display limit, not PIN expiry.

Accepted status pairing_revision and accepted prepare quiesced_revision equal SHA256 of bytes halo-pairing-manifest-v1\0 plus sorted compact JSON manifest. Exact file-byte hashes are opaque metadata, never file contents. Prepare compares expected revision again after quiescence. Durable reset journal/FD lock authority belongs to Python; no child command deletes pairings.

Recording settings expected_revision and accessory_recording.revision are per-camera preference CAS tokens. Global owner revision remains distinct. Tokens change on each actual preference mutation, protecting concurrent cameras and rejecting stale same-camera and ABA writes.

control_state_result only returns fresh normalized observed light/siren state from current trusted scope; unknown is null. Accepted control_request is admission, never proof desired state was observed. No HAP startup/restore invokes Ring controls.

x-binary-transfer.channel: separate inherited bulk socket; control envelopes never carry media bytes
rules: No bulk bytes until transfer_open has matched a live scoped operation and receiver-issued credit. Python produces snapshots/recording; HAP produces talkback_pcm. S06 implements scoped bounded transport only; actual HomeKit recording, speaker codec/output and snapshot transformations require later slices.

Credits advertise an absolute allowed sequence window [next_sequence,next_sequence+credits), not additive tokens. Repeated credits cannot enlarge the window; no backwards window, gaps, duplicates, overflow or chunks outside the window. The sender must not enqueue more than two chunks or128KiB outstanding per transfer.

Chunk sequence starts0, increases exactly1, and aggregate lengths must equal announced total_bytes; chunk length<=chunk_bytes and remaining total. Validate the fixed header before bounded allocation; never allocate total_bytes from untrusted metadata.

transfer_end announces exact sequence_count and total_bytes; complete result is sent only after exact payload validation/consumption. Transfer descriptor, direction, scope, operation and byte accounting must match for every header/control message.

Cancel, deadline, scope/boot retirement or socket close revokes credit and discards pending bytes. No new body is enqueued after the synchronized fence; already transmitted/kernel-queued bytes cannot be recalled. Late control/headers cannot revive a retired transfer.
S06 owns finite transfer registry, aggregate memory/concurrency, deadlines and cancellation. IPC limits do not bound HDS library internal buffers or prove HKSV delivery.

Ordinary per-transfer cancel fences delivery and drains only already credited frames to producer sequence_count/sent_bytes. transfer_fence_ack echoes the producer fence UUID and frontier, releasing charged slots exactly once. Native cleanup reservations can outlive drained wire state; malformed/undrained frontiers still retire the channel.

x-literal-text-policy: Unicode16 Cc/Cf/Cs ranges frozen in homekit/text.py and Node FORBIDDEN_TEXT_RANGES; independent of host Unicode database.
